title: ERP return activities (queue 'erp')
description: erp.authorize-return takes return-requested.v1.json and returns ErpReturnDecision; erp.complete-return takes CompleteReturnRequest and returns CompleteReturnResult. The only non-retryable failure type is ValidationFailed (malformed request, unknown or Rejected return on complete). A business refusal is decision 'Rejected', not a failure. ReturnProcessingWorkflow also accepts the signal goodsReceived({receivedBy}).

erpReturnId.description: Empty when the order is unknown (nothing stored).

completed.description: false when already completed; stock is added once.

receivedBy.description: Informational only; signals are not authenticated yet.
